onboarding.title: Welcome to SPMC 2027
onboarding.body: Start by scanning the QR code printed on your ticket to access your personal schedule, digital ticket, and notifications.

schedule.loginPromptHint: You need to log in to save favourite sessions.
schedule.emptyHint: Browse the program and mark the sessions you don't want to miss.

more.title: More
more.pushIosNotInstalled: On iPhone, notifications only work after installing the app on the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) and opening it from there. Requires iOS 16.4 or later.

login.subtitle: Point the camera at the QR code printed on your Pretix ticket.

ticket.title: My Ticket
ticket.notice: This screen identifies you as a participant in the app. For physical check-in at the congress, use the original ticket (PDF/email) sent by Pretix. Check-in status updates every time you open this screen.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.hint: Check the address or go back home.

install.iosHint: Tap Share and then "Add to Home Screen".
